consequence.statement: This is a new feature addition with no operational consequence for environments not using OTLP ingestion; environments using OTLP gain new per-tenant configuration capability.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds support for per-tenant configuration to map OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) data to Loki format.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence does not specify the configuration family (config-key, helm-value, crd-field), path, or component for this per-tenant OTLP mapping configuration; applicability: the evidence does not specify what configuration keys, defaults, or deployment patterns enable or use this per-tenant OTLP mapping feature, making exposure conditions undeterminable
